upside_risks: Clone archival eliminates more work than estimated (Packs C/D are 88% clone — 500 items → ~130 each. If stems are more clone-like than assumed, even fewer seeds need rewriting).
Pack E rewrites may be faster than 35/session if stem-EC-distractor are done together per item (triple-purpose pass = fewer sessions).
Multi-agent parallelism with 3+ agents (different packs) could compress calendar timeline by 40-50%.
Difficulty recalibration is purely label changes — 80+ items/session is achievable, reducing the 5-session estimate to ~3.
downside_risks: Pack E EC authorship is harder than estimated: 500 items with unique independent pipeline means no template shortcuts. Each needs full accounting concept research per CAQS §4.
DL-016 Pack A metadata-content shift affects all 500 items — choices in metadata block don't match content block. Fixing this may require per-item line-level edits, increasing effort.
Pack C Section B DL-008 cluster (54 items) has CC rotation artifacts — EW[CC] clears alone may not be sufficient. May need full CC audit → re-certification pass.
Case bank distractor authorship requires case-scenario context awareness — slower than MCQ distractor authoring. May exceed the 6-session estimate.
Governance-guard Rule 5 (max 30 items/batch) limits throughput. Complex rewrites that would naturally go faster (e.g., 40/session) are artificially capped.

Dual-object architecture (Packs B/C/D/E) requires string-aware parsers for every edit. DL-020 (validator brace-matcher) and DL-029 (scan false positives) show that even read tools are unreliable on this format.
recommended_mitigations: Execute clone archival FIRST — unblocks all downstream estimates. Do not start rewrites on items that will be archived.
Author a 'Pack E rewrite template' for each section — standard EC structure, common principle citations per topic — to accelerate the 500-item rewrite.
Fix DL-016 Pack A as a structural pass (not per-item) — the +1 offset is systematic and may be correctable via a targeted script rather than per-item edits.
Use multi-agent sessions: Agent 1 works Pack E, Agent 2 works Pack A DL-013, Agent 3 works case bank EW. Different files, no concurrent-write risk.
Run delivery pool safety checks after every phase, not just at end. Catch regressions early.
